judged_text: guests: z.array(z.string().email()) has no maximum length, so a single addGuests mutation accepts an unbounded email list. One authenticated call from an organizer or attendee creates thousands of attendee rows via createMany, fires thousands of outbound emails in sendAddGuestsEmails, and pushes the full list into updateCalendarAttendees — a one-request spam/DoS amplifier that burns the sender's mail reputation and the organizer's calendar API quota, with no cap or rate limit anywhere in the path.

adjudication.rationale: The new TRPC input schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` allows `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no `.max(...)` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts). The handler then `createMany` inserts all provided guests (addGuests.handler.ts) and `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` iterates attendees to send emails (packages/emails/email-manager.ts), and `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` receives the full expanded attendee list. This makes the mutation a potential one-request spam/DoS amplifier via an unbounded guest list size, which is a real security/performance defect visible in the diff.
